किन्तु उसे वैसी ही सुविधाएँ भगवान्‌ के शुद्ध भक्तों द्वारा, शास्त्रों के आदेशों द्वारा (जैसाकि विशेष रूप

हृदय से भगवान्‌ की सेवा में निष्ठा रखता है, उसके समक्ष भगवान्‌ स्वयं गुरु रूप में प्रकट होते हैं ।

in the first verse, Shri Bhagwan initiated Brahma from within his heart. God is within each
soul, situated as the Supreme Soul, and he initiated Brahma because he
was eager to take initiation.
Similarly, whoever is willing to take initiation, God can give initiation to him. As it has been told, Brahma is the original guru of this universe, and since God himself had initiated him,
therefore, the story of Shrimad Bhagwat has been going on through the disciple tradition, that is why to get the real story (message) of Shrimad Bhagwat,
a person should go to the guru who has been going on through the disciple tradition. Then, in that tradition, after being initiated by a worthy guru, one should engage in penance to worship him.
One should become absorbed in it. But considering himself equal to Brahma, one should not think of being initiated directly by God,

A human being, by obtaining this divine sound from a suitable source, accepting it as truth, without any hesitation,
has to follow it as an order. The secret of success is that sound should be received from an authentic guru, that is,
from a suitable source. In worldly artificial sounds, there is no power; therefore, in the so-called divine sound obtained from an unreliable person, there is no power. One should have the ability to know such divine power,

to follow the orders of the authentic guru with complete faith is the secret to success.
Brahmaji gained control over both types of his senses, the sensory organs of action and the sensory organs of knowledge,
because their use was to be in obeying the orders of God. Therefore, the meaning of controlling the senses is
to engage them in the divine service of God. God's order is revealed through an authentic guru to the disciple-
tradition, therefore, following the order of an authentic guru means truly
controlling the senses. With complete faith and devotion, by doing such penance, Brahmaji could become so powerful
that he became the destroyer of the universe. It is because of attaining such power that they are called the best among ascetics.

Thinking like this is indicative of a lack of knowledge,
Otherwise, why would anyone have such a fear of emptiness in Brahman? Just as there are airplanes, ships, and men there, similarly, according to the particular locality, there would also be cities, houses, and other things. and the atmosphere

wise councilors-- such as his secretary, private secretary, minister, advisor. Similarly, when we
see God, then along with him, his various powers, councilors, trusted servants, etc., also
see. Therefore, God, who is the master of all beings, all devotee communities, and sacrifices, and
